objective: Make Codex and Cursor build offloads return a structured result that a named wrapper validates against a JSON schema and then verifies against the repository before a build is reported as done.
why: ac7-1 and ac7-2 are not-verified. No wrapper or result schema exists in bin/, and builds are reported from the build agent's own text. A schema checks shape only: past misreports (a contaminated diff and a hidden red CI and a branch on the wrong base) would pass it. So the wrapper must also check the claims against git. Codex exec supports --output-schema. cursor-agent JSON output wraps free text and has no schema option, so the wrapper's own check is the only check on that path.

include: A JSON schema for the offload result (status and files changed and checks run with results and commit SHA and base branch and open issues)
A bin/ wrapper that runs codex exec with --output-schema or cursor-agent with JSON output and validates the result with jq assertions
A drift test that keeps the jq assertions in line with the schema file
Independent checks: the commit SHA exists and git diff --name-only from the base to the SHA matches files changed and the merge-base matches the expected base
Run the repository's own configured checks and never a command taken from the agent output
Separate exit codes for CLI failure and schema failure and verification failure
Tests for an invalid shape and for a valid shape with a commit SHA that does not exist
Offload guidance in docs/harnesses/ that points builds at the wrapper
